TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Transaction to execute the creation of the massive pricing rules
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() reads pricingRuleRequest and calls ABKOR001.executePostMassivePricingRules(pricingRuleRequest). In ABKOR001Impl.executePostMassivePricingRules, validateMassivePricingRuleRequest rejects a null request or null details, requires at least two ACT details, rejects duplicated ACT ids, and rejects any detail with null entityType or id. buildMassivePricingRules copies the input into one PricingRuleDTO per ACT detail, validatePostPricingRule validates effectiveDate.startDate and effectiveDate.endDate through PricingRuleValidator.validatePost, checks duplicates, and resolves each detail value before persistence. 2. Decisions and branches: getActivityDetails keeps only details whose entityType is ACT, while buildMassivePricingRules copies non-ACT and non-CUS details into every generated rule and adds one copied ACT detail per rule. PricingRuleDuplicateValidator.checkIfPricingRuleAlreadyExistsForPost returns without duplicate checks when details is null or empty, PostPricingRuleDuplicateValidator.handleVariableExactMatch throws when an exact variable candidate exists, handlePaymentMethodOverlap throws when variable rules share payment methods, and validateRegulatedCandidates only checks regulated candidates when variable payment methods are present. insertMassiveCustomAttribute throws when the insert result is 0. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() obtains ABKOR001 through getServiceLibrary and calls executePostMassivePricingRules. ABKOR001Impl.executePostMassivePricingRules validates the massive request, generates one rule per ACT detail, validates each generated rule, reads the audit user from the request header, obtains IDs from PricingRuleRepository.getNextCustomAttributeId, getNextCustomAttributeBatchId, and getNextId, inserts the audit row and the massive custom attribute, appends a CUS detail with value MASIVA to each generated rule, and persists each rule through persistNewPricingRule, which inserts the pricing rule row and its detail rows. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: validateMassivePricingRuleRequest throws ABKO10010420 when pricingRuleDTO is null, pricingRuleDTO.getDetails() is null, or fewer than two ACT details are present, ABKO10010421 when an ACT detail id is null or repeated, and ABKO10010422 when any detail, detail entityType, or detail id is null. PricingRuleValidator.validatePost throws ABKO10000404 when endDate is before startDate. UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPricingRuleAlreadyExists throws ABKO10010401 when an exact duplicate candidate has the same fee, handleVariableExactMatch throws ABKO10010402 when an exact variable duplicate has a different fee, UtilPrDuplicateValidation.throwPaymentMethodOverlap throws ABKO10010415 when a variable rule overlaps by payment method, PricingRuleRepository.fillDetailValues throws ABKO10010004 when no query exists for a detail type, when the resolved value is blank, or when the detail id is not found, and insertMassiveCustomAttribute throws ABKO00000010 when the massive custom attribute insert affects zero rows. executePostMassivePricingRules catches PricingRuleException, adds the advice with the propagated code and description, returns an empty list, and assignSeverityError sets Severity.EWR when the advice list is not empty. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: execute() always calls setPricingrulesresponse with the list returned by executePostMassivePricingRules, even when that list is empty after an advice. Each returned PricingRuleDTO receives its id in persistNewPricingRule, keeps the copied name, fee, effectiveDate, comments, pricingRuleType, precedenceType, progressiveType, and status, returns copied details with repository-filled values, and includes the appended CUS detail with value MASIVA.
